name: DiscoveryBench
why_it_matters: Data journalists routinely need to surface the underlying story or finding hidden in messy spreadsheets, which is exactly what this benchmark measures.
task_shape: Given a natural-language research goal and one or more real-world datasets (CSVs), the model must autonomously perform analysis and produce a verifiable hypothesis or finding that matches a ground-truth discovery.
signals: Uses 264 real data-driven discovery tasks across domains like sociology, economics, and biology, grounded in published findings.
Tasks are framed around known published hypotheses, so success may reward rediscovery rather than genuinely novel angle-finding a reporter would value.
